sources.publisher: Oncor Electric Delivery / Public Utility Commission of Texas
sources.title: Chronic Condition, Critical Care, Critical Load (16 TAC §25.497 as posted by Oncor)
sources.scopeNote: Rule text (Oncor-hosted 25.497.pdf, fetched 2026-10-18): critical care designation = person dependent on an electric-powered medical device to sustain life, effective two years; chronic condition generally 90 days; physician submits the commission form to the TDU; qualifies for notification of interruptions and certain disconnection protections; designation does not guarantee the uninterrupted supply of electricity.
